title: KOWA
description: [AI generated] Kowa Company, Ltd. is a Japanese diversified corporation headquartered in Nagoya, Japan, founded in 1894. It operates across multiple industries, including pharmaceuticals, optical products (cameras, lenses, binoculars), textiles, electronics, trading, and industrial machinery. Kowa is particularly known for its pharmaceutical division and precision optical instruments. The company operates both domestically and internationally, with subsidiaries and distribution networks across Asia, North America, and Europe.
